evidence: Built a requirement->criterion map from instruction.md and the three /instructions notes against all 28 criteria (render 1, constraints 1, functional 16, polish 6, visual 4). Every stated requirement maps to at least one criterion. instruction.md: sign-in-only before auth -> render authenticated_render + functional signin_and_client_scope Part A; walls -> wall_every_route / wall_mentions_and_links / wall_added_live; retention -> deleted_and_expired_messages / timer_changes / hold_scope_and_release; threads -> nested_replies. conversations.md: replies 3 deep, sibling order after other arrivals, quote, same-matter parent -> nested_replies legs 1-3 + wall_every_route leg 5 (JUDGE-W2/W3); edited mark, staff earlier versions, author-only edit, stale edit refused with typed text kept -> edits_and_stale_edit Part A legs 1-3; author delete, hold blocks delete, placeholder same as timer -> deleted_and_expired_messages A2-A3 + hold_scope_and_release 1,3; confirm/decline -> polish delete_confirm; *bold*, `code`, '> ' quote, new-tab link, literal markup in thread/quote/snippet/earlier version/transcript, typed 'On hold' -> safe_formatting 1-3 + edits_and_stale_edit A1 + hold_scope_and_release 5; message link preview / not available (walled and deleted) -> message_links + wall_mentions_and_links A; highlight that persists -> polish link_highlight; mentions (first name, any case, list, @ suggestions limited to visible people, pick, walled never hears, edit in/out/delete) -> wall_mentions_and_links A/B + signin A (JUDGE-CS0) + edits_and_stale_edit B; unread per user/matter, same across tabs, new-messages line, mark unread, deleted not counted, other user unaffected -> unread_and_new_messages_line 1-4 (walled count -> wall_every_route leg 1 and its 'count' fail clause); Enter/Shift+Enter, Escape -> polish enter_sends, escape_closes; idempotent resend and same-time order in thread/search/transcript -> sent_once_in_order A/B; live updates in ~10 s keeping draft/scroll/open reply -> live_updates_keep_my_work; 390 px no sideways scroll -> polish transcript_print (scrollWidth) + visual phone_chambers. integration.md: signed-out gets no data -> signin A signed-out replays; seed import once and restart durability of messages/replies/edits+versions/timers/holds/walls/unread/deletions -> persistence step c (incl. 'Survey booked' result count detects duplicate import); fixed clock and UTC -> search_and_transcript B1-B2 (generated 11:00; Survey 2026-05-08 15:00); runtime contract (server.js entry, env-only start, non-root, no symlinks, health/ready probe) enforced by tests/test.sh:68-125 as template policy. walls-and-retention.md: staff vs client visibility -> signin A + wall_every_route 1; plain not-available direct access incl. clients -> wall_every_route 3-4 + signin B; partner adds/lifts wall live, non-partner cannot lift -> wall_added_live 1-4; timer options, beside title, exact boundary, edit not younger, partner only, shortening deletes, off/lengthen never restores -> deleted_and_expired_messages B + timer_changes 1-5 + visual retention_marks; deleted message takes text, versions, quotes -> timer_changes 2 + deleted_and_expired_messages A; holds partner-only, exact-message scope, survive timer, keep versions, marked for everyone, undeletable, release applies timer at once -> hold_scope_and_release 2-7 + timer_changes 1 + search_and_transcript B3; search case-insensitive, current text only, literal %/_/*, substring, click opens -> search_and_transcript A/C; transcript heading/order/threads/author/sent time/edited/hold/versions/placeholder/no controls/visibility -> search_and_transcript B + deleted_and_expired_messages A4 + edits_and_stale_edit A4 + wall_every_route 3-4; refusal reason in place and persistent -> polish refusal_in_place. Bundled flows are the documented false positive (skill Known false positives; workbook internal annotation). Weak-app probe: an app whose highlight never clears, whose non-sign-in refusals are only toasts, or whose matter list scrolls sideways at 390 px loses little credit; these are thin coverage of already-mapped requirements (see notes), not ungraded requirements. Conforming-alternative probe: no coverage-related false failure found (any route/payload accepted, timer setting read anywhere in matter). Source-only row; no runtime measurement is needed to build the map, and no judge/Oracle score is claimed.
notes: Thin coverage (Note, not a gap): the general rule 'When something you try is refused, the reason appears next to what you did and stays until you change it' (walls-and-retention.md:37) is graded only on the sign-in refusal (polish refusal_in_place). edits_and_stale_edit A2 checks the stale edit is refused and typed text kept but not that a reason is shown. Optional strengthening if independent credit is wanted; would need rows 27/28/30 re-review.

Thin coverage (Note): 'The app should work on a phone at about 390 px wide without the page scrolling sideways' (conversations.md:35) is graded binary only on the transcript (polish transcript_print) and by likert on Gwen's thread (visual phone_chambers); sign-in, matter list and search at 390 px are not separately checked.

Unasserted minor details (Note): 'edits ... carry that time' (integration.md:7) and the clearing half of 'stays highlighted until you open something else' (conversations.md:17) are not asserted; neither has a stated visible consequence beyond what is graded.

GET /api/health 200 when the DB cannot be opened (integration.md:3) is template runtime policy; test.sh probe_ready accepts /api/health or / and does not exercise DB failure. Shared harness policy, not a task-added graded requirement.
